about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm from Taubaté (SP, Brazil) and currently studying Systems Analysis and Development at SENAI Félix Guisard. I have a strong interest in technology and constantly seek to expand my knowledge, always focused on deeply understanding how solutions are built.
about.p2: I enjoy learning by doing and building end-to-end web applications — from interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to back-end APIs with Python, FastAPI, Django, Node.js, and PostgreSQL databases.
